questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle means you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This emblem is displayed on slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn carts, or farm equipment. It warns other drivers that the vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery and harder to drive on safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a road with two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop so other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians can pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line and only proceed when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk or at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no passing zone begins.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to immediate road conditions. This sign warns that lanes ahead are being reduced and drivers must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign showing a traffic signal means a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. Orange warning signs indicate construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending and traffic may need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you go. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that another road is crossing the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that are traveling slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. A bicyclist signals a left turn by extending their left arm straight out.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red arrow pointing left means you must come to a complete stop. Stay stopped until the red arrow is no longer displayed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs indicate a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop when you see these signs.
